subject: Backend Engineer, Payments
body:
Hi Dana,

You're listed as the recruiter on Northwind Pay's Backend Engineer, Payments post. It asks for experience with recurring card mandates, which has been most of my last 4 years.

At Tidewater Freight I led the mandate retry service in Go, which handles about 1 million requests a day. I applied on 20 September, and my notice period is 30 days.

Is the role still open, and does my background fit the level you're hiring for?

Thanks,

R1.text: Northwind Pay job post, Backend Engineer, Payments, posted 2026-09-12. Meet the hiring team: Dana Cruz, Talent Partner. Requirements: recurring card mandates, Go, Postgres.
R1.snippet: Meet the hiring team: Dana Cruz, Talent Partner. Requirements: recurring card mandates, Go, Postgres.

R2.text: Northwind Pay engineering blog, 2026-07-15: post-mortem of the card retry spike, where retries piled up behind one slow issuing bank.
R2.snippet: post-mortem of the card retry spike, where retries piled up behind one slow issuing bank

profile_facts.P1: 4 years building Go payment services at Tidewater Freight.
profile_facts.P2: Led the mandate retry service at Tidewater Freight, about 1 million requests per day.
profile_facts.P4: Applied to Northwind Pay Backend Engineer, Payments on 20 September 2026.
profile_facts.P5: Fixed a retry storm behind a slow partner bank in 2025 with per-bank retry budgets; duplicate charge complaints fell from about 30 a week to 3.

note: recruiter gets the req, the fit and the logistics
